variants: Adjust to the user's real body of work and hanging order

Real work images and captions come from the user or an explicit confirmation
responsive: 1440px: one lead work with label, then a three-up hang

html:
Room / EXHIBITION Original demo works · not a real exhibition

See one work.
Then the next.

The room hangs in chronological order. Each work carries a single label: number, medium, year. The rest is left to look at. Every work and author on this page is original demo content.

Enter the second room
02

Second room: material

Three works, one batch of material handled three ways.

Beyond the label

A label carries facts only: number, medium, year. Motivation stays off the wall. This is an original demo page and points to no real exhibition, author or collection.

Why the label holds three items

Three items locate the work without interrupting it. More context belongs in a companion note, not on the label.
